pr_title: Add fitCriteria parameter to ChangePixelFormat command
pr_body:
Fix #4781 

This PR also includes:
- A refactor of ChangePixelFormatCommand to make it inherit from CommandWithNewParams.
- A new "dithering-factor" parameter to being able to specify this for the "error-diffusion" dithering algorithm.
- A commit to avoid the BayerMatrix object slicing, not actually needed.
pr_comments:
Merged in 5e40e5544 + 91b360319 + b1d739608

Patch 5e40e5544 includes the following 3 fixups squashed. About the object slicing issue, although only an issue when derived classes have additional members, it's better just to completely avoid it. I gonna make DitheringMatrix a final class.

issue_context.title: Add bestFitCriteria param to ChangePixelFormat command
comments:
I do not have pull permissions, but I believe I have a working implementation. I also am uploading a lua script I created to test that it is working.

Patch -- [0001-lua-4781-add-bestFitCriteria-param-to-ChangePixelFor.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18068769/0001-lua-4781-add-bestFitCriteria-param-to-ChangePixelFor.patch)


Script -- [best_fit_criteria copy.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18068595/best_fit_criteria.copy.txt)

@OwenJRoth thank you for taking the time to make an implementation! However, we also want to change the way the command parameters are handled by the new CommandWithNewParams. So I will be working on this now.
